title: Minor dynasties: more lines, vassals, Palnadu detail

boxes.title: Chalukya-Chola line: more
items: Kulottunga I married ==**Madhurantaki**==, daughter of Chola Rajendra
Gonka I fought off **Kalyani Chalukyas** and **Kalingas**
**Mandaleswaras** raised by Kulottunga I: Velanati, Nellore, Telugu, Konidena, Pottapi Chodas; **Giri Paschima Durjayas**; **Natavadis**; ==**Chagis**==; Kona Haihayas

boxes.title: More lines & added detail
head: Line
Point
rows: Descent from ==**Kartavirya Arjuna**==; feudatories of Velanati Chodas
Grouped with ==**Ananda Gotrikas**==; early Telugu records, hero-stones, small temples

boxes.title: Velanati & Kota: more
items: Velanati rulers named sons after Chalukya-Chola overlords (**Rajendra Choda** first)
Last Velanati member: **Mummadi Rajendra Choda**; Nellore Choda ==**Tikkana**== helped Ganapati kill **Prithvisvara**
Kota founder **Betaraju I**; land from **Tripurantakam** to Nellore, incl. **Amaravati**
**Bhimaraju II**: absorbed **Kondapadamati**; title ==**Dannala Kota Padaveshtita Kadana**==

boxes.title: Palnadu & records: more
items: Nagamma built **Veerabhadra Swamy** temple; ==opposed Brahmanaidu's reforms==
Palnadu called ==**Reddi-dominated**== in APPSC GS 2018 key
**Taruvariyur**: Manumasiddi I as a =="thunderbolt to enemies"==
